name: Synthetic
note: Quota only, and the first of these that is a proper meter with a reset: the subscription reports a request ceiling, the requests spent against it and when it renews, so the bar fills and empties rather than counting money down. The figures are requests rather than tokens — Synthetic bills per request — so a long conversation and a one-line question cost the same, which is the service's own accounting and not a simplification here. An account with no subscription reports a ceiling of nought and charts nothing, because nought of nothing is not nought per cent.

compatibility.note: Mapping is fixture-verified against the published response shape; the numbers themselves are unconfirmed against a live account.
